summary: Tested Ready To Sail badge, Magic Fish Whisperer (backend + UI, one real AI fish ID with GPS), catch log, add to Common Meals, Magic Bartender simplification, magic row icons and app menu, at desktop 1920 and mobile 390. Everything requested works. Backend: 14/15 new pytest cases pass. The one exception is skipped, not failed: the Pro gate on /api/ai/fish can't be exercised right now because launch_free (FIRST200) makes free users premium. One real not_fish call via the API returned not_fish=true, a message and asks_left, and saved nothing. No functional bugs found.

minor.issue: Couldn't verify the Pro gate (402/403) for free users. launch_free/first200 currently makes test-user-free premium=true, so a free user gets 200 and the AI call runs. This matches the other Magic features via require_premium.

A not_fish reply still uses up one daily Magic generation, because quota.consume runs before parsing and is only refunded on exception. Product decision whether a 'not a fish' photo should be refunded.

issues: crew-ready-count is always green (var(--green)), even when it reads '0 of 1 ready to sail'. Consider a muted/amber colour when it isn't all ready.
bartender-batch-scan-btn label 'Photo boat areas with Batch Magic Scan...' is truncated with an ellipsis at 390px width.

For crew, BoatDetails isn't rendered, so there is no boat-details-fish-btn icon. Fish Whisperer is only reachable from the app menu (app-menu-fish-item works for crew, and bartender is correctly hidden). Fine if intended.

catch-log-delete-btn + catch-delete-confirm-btn -> DELETE 200, toast 'Catch removed from your log', item removed, count back to (1)
